input_settings.purpose: Matched exchange-only atomic calculations and diffuse negative-energy virtual-state analysis.
input_settings.negative_virtual_definition: occupation <= occupation_threshold and orbital energy < negative_virtual_threshold_ha
input_settings.degeneracy_grouping: energy-sorted states within degeneracy_tolerance_ha of the first state in the current group

he_basis_sensitivity.generated_exponent_rule: alpha_new = alpha_most_diffuse^2 / alpha_next_diffuse for each angular momentum; contraction coefficient 1

definitions.open_shell: UKS alpha and beta occupation masks analyzed separately; counts are spin-orbital diagnostics
definitions.l_estimate: dominant angular-momentum weight of the MO in the AO overlap metric
